weakness: OT account management undefined; departed staff kept VPN accounts; shared operator password not rotated; OT accounts not on termination checklist
remediation_plan: Named HMI accounts; OT and VPN accounts on the termination checklist; monthly OT account reconciliation; quarterly review by Chief Plant Operators
milestones: 2026-10-31 termination checklist updated and stale VPN accounts removed; 2026-12-31 named accounts live and first quarterly review

weakness: Remote access undocumented, password-only, and lands directly on the HMI subnet
remediation_plan: Remote access gateway in the OT DMZ with MFA, per-session approval, time limits, and recording; retire direct VPN to HMIs
milestones: 2026-09-30 gateway installed; 2026-10-31 all remote access moved and old paths closed

weakness: Integrator remote maintenance unapproved, unmonitored, password-only, and always connected
remediation_plan: Remove the always-on agent now; integrator uses the gateway with Chief Plant Operator approval and session recording; maintenance records kept
milestones: 2026-08-14 agent disabled outside scheduled windows (interim); 2026-10-31 agent removed and gateway in use

weakness: No MFA for privileged OT access or remote access
remediation_plan: Federate gateway and VPN to the identity provider with MFA; phishing-resistant authenticators for administrators and the integrator
milestones: 2026-10-31 MFA enforced on all remote paths

weakness: Commissioning and default passwords; weak HMI administrator passwords; device passwords in a plain spreadsheet
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives, new finding IA-05e.); P01 R-031
remediation_plan: Change all commissioning passwords; password vault for device credentials; modem hardening standard; quarterly check for default credentials
milestones: 2026-08-06 modem web admin disabled and passwords changed (done); 2026-10-31 vault in use; 2026-12-31 all HMI and PLC passwords changed
resources_required: Password vault ($1,200 per year); integrator 24 hours

weakness: No backup of PLC logic or HMI projects; no offline or encrypted OT backup
source: P07 assessment (CP-09 objectives); P01 R-006; P03 G-033
remediation_plan: Monthly and after-change export of PLC logic and HMI projects to encrypted offline media in two locations; quarterly comparison with running logic
milestones: 2026-09-30 first full export; 2026-10-15 procedure approved and second location in use

weakness: ERP lacks recovery objectives, SCADA compromise and restoration procedures, and protection of the plan
source: P07 assessment (CP-02 objectives); P03 G-012 to G-014
remediation_plan: Revise the ERP with BIA recovery objectives, the OT cyber annex (P08), OT recovery procedure, annual review, and restricted access; certify to EPA
milestones: 2026-11-13 RRA cyber addendum; 2026-12-11 revised ERP approved and certified (deadline 2026-12-26)

weakness: No incident response plan at the time of fieldwork
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook as the cyber incident response plan inside the ERP; distribute to operators, IT, and the integrator; restrict and version-control it
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook approved (done); 2026-12-11 incorporated in the certified ERP

weakness: No cyber incident handling capability for OT
remediation_plan: Forensic support through the cyber insurer's panel; incident log; OT tabletop with the integrator; logging and monitoring from POAM-011 and POAM-012
milestones: 2026-10-31 insurer panel and retainer confirmed; 2026-11-30 first OT tabletop; 2027-03-31 detection sources live

weakness: No internal segmentation; historian dual-homed; boundary not monitored
source: P07 assessment (SC-07 objectives); P01 R-003; P03 G-037; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: OT DMZ with one-way historian replica path; remove dual-homing; deny-by-default rules; separate HMI and PLC zones
milestones: 2026-11-30 design approved; 2027-02-28 DMZ built; 2027-03-31 old rules removed

weakness: No security monitoring of the OT network or SCADA hosts
source: P07 assessment (SI-04 objectives); P01 R-009; P03 G-039
remediation_plan: Passive OT network monitoring sensor at WTP-1 with alerts to the IT Manager and Operations Manager
milestones: 2026-12-31 sensor purchased; 2027-03-31 alerting live and tuned

weakness: No review of OT or firewall logs; short retention
source: P07 assessment (AU-06 objectives); P03 G-036, G-040
remediation_plan: Forward HMI, firewall, VPN, and gateway logs to the log workspace with 1-year retention; weekly documented review
milestones: 2027-01-31 log forwarding; 2027-03-31 weekly reviews documented

weakness: No OT patches since 2023; unsupported OS; VPN firmware behind
source: P07 assessment (SI-02 objectives); P01 R-005; P03 G-035
remediation_plan: Patch VPN now; quarterly vendor-qualified OT patch window; upgrade SCADA servers and engineering workstation in the 2027 capital plan
milestones: 2026-09-15 VPN patched; 2026-12-31 first quarterly OT patch window; 2027-06-30 OS upgrade complete

weakness: No vulnerability or external exposure scanning
remediation_plan: Quarterly external exposure scan; annual passive OT vulnerability review; request EPA's free Water Sector Cybersecurity Evaluation
milestones: 2026-10-31 first company-run scan; 2026-12-31 EPA evaluation requested and first OT review

weakness: OT inventory out of date (14 devices missing)
remediation_plan: Build the OT inventory with model, firmware, location, address, and owner; quarterly review
milestones: 2026-10-31 inventory complete; quarterly reviews thereafter

weakness: Engineering workstation runs unneeded software; insecure protocols allowed across the IT/OT firewall

milestones: 2026-10-31 software removed; 2027-03-31 ports and protocols closed with POAM-010

weakness: Remote agent and engineering users run as administrators

milestones: 2026-10-31 separate administrator accounts

weakness: Shared HMI operator login
remediation_plan: Named HMI accounts for each operator with role-based privileges; quick-switch login so alarm response is not delayed
milestones: 2026-11-30 integrator configures named accounts; 2026-12-31 shared login disabled

weakness: No role-based security training for OT roles
remediation_plan: Annual OT role-based training for operators, SCADA technicians, and the IT Manager, using free federal water-sector training resources where suitable
milestones: 2027-01-31 first sessions complete for all 18 operations staff

weakness: No automated monitoring or control of remote sessions
